# Report 10 tables (generated by results/exp10/report10.py)

Physics-based drift (SI1000 base device, p=0.0015, device seed 0), 6 regimes x stream seeds (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), 1500 sub-steps x 200 shots each, pooled over stream seeds. Existing d=5 models only (seeds 0-1-2 ensembles, mean logit > 0), evaluated causally in 200-shot sub-batches on ensemble_eval.py's path. Frozen = fingerprint of the 2000-shot static-device calibration set. McNemar exact two-sided on shared shots; event-level exact two-sided sign tests (ties dropped) over the events each regime has (phys_mixed: bursts + TLS + couplers; phys_slow and phys_static have no events); p < 0.001 significant (bold), 0.001-0.05 weak, no correction. The best WindowDEM window is picked per regime and slice after the fact.

| phys_tls | 7500 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0/992/0 |
| phys_cosmic | 747 | 6753 | 327 | 251 | 161 | 9 | 1 | 10/0/0 |
| phys_slow | 7500 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0/0/0 |
| phys_coupler | 1720 | 5780 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0/0/27 |
| phys_mixed | 7500 | 0 | 327 | 251 | 161 | 9 | 0 | 10/992/27 |

Bins follow the youngest active burst's amplitude; they can include sub-steps whose max burst is < 0.005 (impact far from every qubit), and drift by max burst can occur with no active burst (summed older bursts) — the edge case allowed for in the definitions.

## Hypotheses (notes/10_physics_drift_hypotheses.md)

| H | statement | verdict | deciding numbers (drift sub-steps, pooled seeds) |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | adaptive-stale ensemble (live) beats its frozen version on drift steps of phys_tls, phys_cosmic, phys_mixed (McNemar p < 0.001 and event sign p < 0.01) | **FAIL** | tls: ΔLER +3.07e-05, p=0.06, sign 299/581, p=0.5; cosmic: ΔLER +3.09e-03, p=0.008, sign 0/10, p=0.002; mixed: ΔLER +1.41e-04, p=0.2, sign 384/675, p=0.0004 |
| H2 | adaptive-stale ensemble (live) beats calibrated MWPM and the best WindowDEM on drift steps of phys_cosmic and phys_mixed (p < 0.001) | **FAIL** | phys_cosmic calibrated MWPM: ΔLER -2.69e-03, p=0.1; phys_cosmic best WindowDEM (500): ΔLER -2.69e-03, p=0.1; phys_mixed calibrated MWPM: ΔLER -1.26e-03, p=9e-14; phys_mixed best WindowDEM (500): ΔLER -1.26e-03, p=9e-14 |
| H3 (risk) | the neural models are worse than calibrated MWPM on the physics base device with no drift | **FAIL** | static_wide: ΔLER -5.98e-04, p=4e-79, better; static_nominal: ΔLER -5.13e-04, p=4e-56, better; adaptive_wide: ΔLER -6.28e-04, p=2e-87, better; adaptive_stale: ΔLER -6.40e-04, p=9e-91, better |

## H1: adaptive-stale ensemble, live vs frozen, drift sub-steps

| regime | ΔLER (live−frozen) | McNemar p | sign test (live better/total, p) | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| phys_tls | +0.00003 | 0.06 | 299/581, p=0.5 | FAIL |
| phys_cosmic | +0.00309 | 0.008 | 0/10, p=0.002 | FAIL |
| phys_mixed | +0.00014 | 0.2 | 384/675, p=0.0004 | FAIL |

Overlapping events share shots, so events are not fully independent; event-level p-values for phys_tls and phys_mixed are approximate.


**H1: FAIL** (all three regimes: live better, McNemar p < 0.001, sign test p < 0.01).

## Exploratory (post hoc)

adaptive-stale ensemble, live vs frozen (the H1 comparison), sliced after the fact. Not hypothesis tests.

| regime | slice | shots | ΔLER (live−frozen) | McNemar p | LER live | LER frozen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| phys_cosmic | burst bin 0.05–0.2 | 65400 | +0.00050 | 0.8 | 0.4919 | 0.4914 |
| phys_cosmic | burst bin 0.0125–0.05 | 50200 | +0.00420 | 0.06 | 0.4670 | 0.4628 |
| phys_cosmic | burst bin 0.005–0.0125 | 32200 | +0.00686 | 5e-07 | 0.2028 | 0.1959 |
| phys_mixed | burst bin 0.05–0.2 | 65400 | -0.00104 | 0.6 | 0.4928 | 0.4938 |
| phys_mixed | burst bin 0.0125–0.05 | 50200 | +0.00349 | 0.1 | 0.4705 | 0.4670 |
| phys_mixed | burst bin 0.005–0.0125 | 32200 | +0.00339 | 0.02 | 0.2143 | 0.2109 |
| phys_mixed | TLS-only drift sub-steps | 1017000 | +0.00002 | 0.5 | 0.00490 | 0.00488 |

Composition of the phys_mixed disagreement between the pooled McNemar (favours frozen) and the event-level sign test (favours live): the pooled McNemar is dominated by burst errors — burst sub-steps are ~10% of drift sub-steps but carry LER ~0.49, favouring frozen — while the sign test is dominated by the numerous TLS events (992 of 1029 events), which favour live. Per-kind event sign counts (live better / frozen better / ties):

- phys_mixed burst events: 4/6/0 (n=10), p=0.8
- phys_mixed tls events: 366/276/350 (n=992), p=0.0004
- phys_mixed coupler events: 14/9/4 (n=27), p=0.4
